title: ClientConfig validation scattered as inline ifs; extract to validate() method
description: In client.rs, JmapClient::new() validates 5 ClientConfig fields with 5 separate if-statements inline. This should be a ClientConfig::validate() -> Result<(), ClientError> method. Benefits: (1) callers can validate a config before passing it to new(), (2) the validation logic is co-located with the type, (3) new() becomes a simple unwrap of validate() + struct init.
